description: What do a project's own documents say about a question, cited to the page? A question answered from one site's own read documents, by Claude, and checked before it is shown: every statement carries quotes, each quote is found again on the page it names, and a statement whose quote or number is not on its page is cut and counted (`n_cut`). `quotes` give the document, its id and the page; `reasoning` is Claude's own and not from the documents; `not_searched` names the documents not read yet. Priced before any call and refused over $0.25 a question (`ask.over_cap`); an account asks at most 100 questions and spends at most $5 with Claude a UTC day (`ask.over_ceiling`, `spend.daily_cap`). `cost` says what the answer spent; the same question over the same pages is answered from memory at $0.

question.description: The question, in any language; numbered parts (1. … 2. …) are answered part by part.

site.description: The site: its id (from list_sites), or a part of its name that names one site only.

skip_pages.description: Read the next pages instead: the number of best-ranked pages an earlier answer already read (its `searched.read`).

name: ask_site
title: Ask a site a question
